index_record.name: TIED configuration report
index_record.description: Central read-only CLI and MCP report of effective TIED runtime configuration with provenance and opt-in secrets.

REQ-TIED_CONFIG_REPORT.name: TIED configuration report
REQ-TIED_CONFIG_REPORT.description: Operators run one command from store or client to see paths, operator toggles, MCP env, ignored shell exports, and where to set each value; secrets redacted unless explicitly requested.

satisfaction_criteria.criterion: Store checkout emits tied-config-report.v1 with disk-resolved store_root and mcp_dist_path.
Client with tied-yaml mcp.json emits client_project_path and operator toggle provenance.
Catalogued operator toggles include effective, source_kind, source_ref, configure_via.
Default report never prints JEV_API_KEY value.
include_secrets / --include-secrets emits catalogued secret values when set.
Wrong shell global path env appears under shell_ignored with disk-effective source.
tied_config_report JSON matches bootstrap builder for fixture cwd.
Bootstrap and MCP unit tests pass.
satisfaction_criteria.metric: node --test tools/bootstrap/lib/tied-config-report.test.mjs; cd mcp-server && npx tsx --test src/tied-config-report.test.ts

index_record.name: Config report architecture
index_record.summary: Single bootstrap buildTiedConfigReport; MCP and CLI are thin transports; no new config authority.

ARCH-TIED_CONFIG_REPORT.name: Config report architecture
ARCH-TIED_CONFIG_REPORT.decision: Configuration report logic lives in tools/bootstrap/lib/tied-config-report.mjs. MCP dynamically imports it from the store checkout; CLI invokes the same module without MCP spawn. tied_config_get_base_path remains the corpus-path introspection surface; tied_config_report is the operator catalog superset.

index_record.name: Config report implementation
index_record.summary: buildTiedConfigReport, tied-config-report-cli.mjs, tied_config_report MCP tool, client shell wrapper.
